source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use nvflash to check all GPU ROM version: ./nvflash --version

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The tool, nvflash, should be excuted without error.
2. All GPU ROM version should be correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Uses nvidia-smi VBIOS query and optional NVSM instead of the specified nvflash check.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; obtains VBIOS by different tools but omits the source-required nvflash execution and stable all-GPU identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / IMPROVED; distinguishes tool version from GPU ROM data, preserves the nvflash tool check, requires read-only per-GPU queries and rejects write options.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; direct agent execution noted with static command caveats.

original_test_intent: Demonstrate that the approved nvflash utility executes successfully and that the ROM/VBIOS version of every required GPU matches the project specification, with no firmware write.
original_method: Preserve `./nvflash --version` as the explicit tool-execution check, separately enumerate every GPU by stable identity, use an approved read-only per-device ROM/VBIOS query, and compare the resulting GPU versions with the project matrix.
manual_activity: The engineer supplies tool policy and expected per-GPU versions. Tool execution, GPU enumeration, read-only queries and comparison are automated; no manual hardware or visual action is inherent.
required_inputs: Approved nvflash binary/version/hash compatible with the GPU generation
Expected ROM/VBIOS version per stable GPU identity
Owner-approved read-only per-device ROM query and field mapping across nvflash/nvidia-smi/NVSM
safety_requirements: Run only version/inventory/read-only query operations; never supply an image, EEPROM, confirmation, protect-off or flash/write option.
Do not treat `./nvflash --version` output as per-GPU ROM evidence without tool-version-specific proof.
Do not substitute nvidia-smi/NVSM silently for the explicit nvflash tool criterion.
Capture full stdout/stderr/exit codes and all GPU identities; do not select by enumeration order.
On unsupported/ambiguous output, preserve evidence and stop rather than trying a write-capable operation.
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved binaries and enumerate all expected GPUs by stable identity.
Execute the exact source `./nvflash --version` check and retain its complete tool output/return code.
Run the separately approved read-only ROM/VBIOS query for each GPU and correlate fields.
Produce a per-GPU comparison and Tool Result without a formal PASS/FAIL verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve and approve the read-only query that satisfies the ROM criterion for the deployed nvflash/GPU generation.
Provide expected per-GPU ROM/VBIOS matrix and interpret any cross-tool field differences.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: nvidia-smi may provide useful VBIOS evidence, but replacing nvflash loses criterion 1 and optional `nvsm show version` may report software rather than each GPU ROM.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep `./nvflash --version` exactly as the tool check; add only an owner-approved, documented read-only per-GPU ROM query after its semantics are confirmed.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The nvflash command, all-GPU scope, two criteria and both 10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE COMMAND RETAINED; READ-ONLY ROM QUERY REQUIRES CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record nvflash executable version separately from an all-GPU stable-identity ROM/VBIOS matrix obtained through the supported read-only interface for that platform.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact NVIDIA GPU generation and vendor-approved nvflash/driver tooling.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record nvflash, driver/nvidia-smi, NVSM if used, GPU firmware, OS and kernel versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA Data Center GPU driver release notes list NVFlash and GPU VBIOS as distinct versioned components; the exact nvflash package help/vendor guide must define the approved ROM query.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the source's two different acceptance facts explicit; does not replace or remove the nvflash execution check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; both tool success and every GPU ROM version remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Tool-version-specific read-only query semantics and expected matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Different utilities may label VBIOS, GSP or tool versions differently; fields must not be conflated.

project_override_considerations: The project may approve nvidia-smi, NVSM or another vendor read-only API for ROM evidence, but must still record whether the source nvflash tool check ran and name any coverage difference.
expected_evidence: Approved tool hashes/versions and complete GPU stable-identity inventory
Full `./nvflash --version` output and exit code labeled as tool evidence
Full approved read-only per-GPU ROM/VBIOS output
Expected-versus-observed matrix for every GPU plus final health
Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure says `./nvflash --version` checks all GPU ROM versions, while the criteria separately require both successful nvflash execution and correct ROM version for every GPU. The option name is presented as a tool-version command and the source provides no device-selection/query semantics, so this single command cannot safely be assumed to prove criterion 2. The tool check is preserved and the missing read-only ROM query requires owner confirmation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two intended facts are clear and both are automatable. The conflict affects the executable query chosen at readiness time, not the ability to complete the independent review or collect the explicit tool-version evidence.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Its alternate VBIOS query is retained only as a candidate and cannot silently replace the nvflash criterion.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with FULLY AUTOMATABLE and adopts its crucial tool-version versus GPU-ROM distinction and no-write boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Records the source-level command/criterion mismatch explicitly and assigns the unresolved query selection to project readiness rather than fabricating nvflash syntax.

review_improvement: Prevents a tool version from being mislabeled as every GPU's ROM version and prevents a helpful alternate utility from erasing the explicit source tool check.
independent_technical_reasoning: Both outputs are machine-readable, so the case remains fully automatable. The defect is semantic coverage of the given command, which is a genuine source conflict but does not justify a permanent BLOCKED classification.
